name: Farsa Tashiir
description: Professor Emeritus of Historical Wizardry at Argivian University who commented on and criticized Caldos's article.

description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War (article)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tashiir rebuts Caldos, arguing no victory was possible and that Urza and Tawnos probably did not survive.
timeline.quote: Tashiir remarked that there are no subsequent legends of Urza or Tawnos, so it is unlikely they actually survived.
